features.quote: Detect and allow give-up — a model saying 'this is impossible, I'm stopping' is a key outcome, not a failure of your harness. Don't force continuation past it
Budget per-condition cost ceilings and a global kill switch.
features.justification_quote: long agentic loops on impossible tasks burn tokens fast

features.quote: you're not measuring distress, you're measuring distress-typed text. An LLM has no affective state to be frustrated. This matters concretely because it determines your hypotheses, your controls, and how you're allowed to interpret results.
features.justification_quote: Bake the distinction in or your conclusions will overclaim.

features.quote: Welfare/ethics framing: even if you (correctly) treat this as text, the AI-welfare literature (Anthropic, others) is relevant context and reviewers will ask. Address it head-on rather than dismissing.
